Learn more about the installation of the Advanced @LIGO@scicomm.xyz pre-stabilized laser system by @mpi_grav and @unihannover@wisskomm.social researchers.

Together with the Laser Zentrum Hannover they built the Advanced @LIGO@scicomm.xyz’s laser sources, based on their experience gained from delevoping and running similar systems at GEO600.
